I replied to Tobias in a thread on his message in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

I got that from the channel's own history from 2025-09-03, which Tobias can read himself since he's a member. Priyanka wrote that label printing had stalled at the Tansley Parcel depots and that "Southgate dispatch has totes stacked beside door 4." Her note closing the incident at 18:43 said "Southgate cleared the backlog."

The channel doesn't give an address or site code for Southgate. There are no Tansley account files under accounts/tansley that Tobias can see, so I had no more detail to add. I skipped the gbrain search because his own channel already had the answer.
